directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 6–12 m³/h and Pumping Pressure 15 MPa. Output is a volume rate. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tractor.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的理论输送量写成6–12 m³/h，把泵送压力写成15 MPa。在拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵这一页，理论输送量是6–12 m³/h，泵送压力是15 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tractor。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tractor: Tractor. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 6–12 m³/h and Pumping Pressure 15 MPa. A number in m³/h is a volume rate, and a number in MPa is pressure. Its subject is Hydraulic Force Torque 275px. Maximum aggregate size is 1–3 cm.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tractor页上的Tractor。河北品锦机械在邢台把拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的理论输送量写成6–12 m³/h，把泵送压力写成15 MPa。邢台这一行没有标出保养小时间隔、密封扭矩、出口国家或工程案例。

body.en: Output is a volume rate. Hopper capacity is 0.25 m³. Stroke length, cycle rate and price are absent from both the caption and this catalogue row. Total Weight 1300 kg.
body.zh: 在拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵这一页，理论输送量是6–12 m³/h，泵送压力是15 MPa。

body.en: Pressure is a separate entry on the same sheet. Maximum aggregate size is 1–3 cm. The Xingtai row does not list a service interval, a seal torque, an export destination or a job case. Those shown extras are still not a stroke length.
body.zh: 河北品锦机械不把这句说明当成拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的铭牌。

heading.zh: 悬挂装置与动力输出用途

body.en: On the Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump sheet, Theoretical Output is 6–12 m³/h and Pumping Pressure is 15 MPa. Total Weight 1300 kg. Hopper capacity is 0.25 m³.
body.zh: 行程、冲次和价格在说明文字和这一行目录里都没有。

question.en: What output does the Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump sheet list?
question.zh: 拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵这一页的输送量标出多少？

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 6–12 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tractor.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是6–12 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tractor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: What pressure entry is on the same sheet?
question.zh: 同一页的压力格是多少？

answer.en: Pumping Pressure is 15 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tractor.
answer.zh: 泵送压力是15 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tractor画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. The sheet leaves stroke length, cycle rate and price unprinted. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tractor.
answer.zh: 没有。这一页没有标出行程、冲次和价格。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tractor画面里印出的数字。
